name: Live Shorts Desk
tagline: Turns a live broadcast into Shorts candidates that wait for your pass first
description: While a live show runs it collects moments that would work as YouTube Shorts and gates each against a locked quality checklist before anything is staged. Nothing publishes on its own; the batch holds until you have passed it by hand. The sharer runs it on a real weather channel, not a demo.
author: MadnessOfMouth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
